description: Learn the basics of electrical power systems, including power generation, transmission, and distribution. This video explains how electrical energy is generated at power plants, transmitted over long distances, and distributed to consumers.

title: ind vs pak ICC World cup 2007
description:
India vs Pakistan – ICC World Twenty20 Final 2007:
A thrilling final between India and Pakistan in the inaugural ICC World Twenty20 tournament. India posted a competitive total and Pakistan fought hard until the final over. India held their nerve to win by 5 runs, becoming the first-ever ICC World Twenty20 champions. A memorable match in cricket history featuring intense rivalry, exciting batting, bowling, and a dramatic finish.
